simple.meaning: אֲמַר (ʼămar) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “command, declare, say, speak, tell.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 71 times across Ezra, Jeremiah, Daniel, beginning at Ezra 5:3. Its contexts include kingship, Israel.
